svg.title: FB_Heater - test H1: 2-point control (SP 60.0, hyst 2.0), no feedback, over-temperature, bad signal
svg.text: FB_Heater - test H1: 2-point control (SP 60.0, hyst 2.0), no feedback, over-temperature, bad signal
Heat ON at rTemp <= SP - hyst = 58.0, OFF at rTemp >= SP = 60.0, unchanged in between. Feedback monitoring tFb = 500 ms in both directions.
tick k (x 100 ms) - events change inputs before the call of that tick
tick 15: 57.5 <= 58 -> qOn, but the contactor feedback stays 0 -> tick 19 (5 calls) alarm 2 ; tick 24 reset -> heats again (58.0 <= 58.0) ;
tick 30: safety thermostat -> alarm 1 ; tick 38 reset accepted ; tick 39: signal bad while enabled -> alarm 3 ; tick 43: disabled + reset -> cleared.
